question: Does going from 2 arms (GR1, action_dim 32) to 4 arms (action_dim 64) cost anything in GR00T's action head?
what_was_measured: The two DoF-dependent action-head sub-graphs (action_encoder + action_decoder) at the bimanual GR1 action_dim 32 (2 arms) vs a SYNTHETIC widened action_dim 64 (4 arms). The 64-wide head was produced by ONNX surgery (duplicate the 32-wide input-projection / output columns). This is MEASURED PERFORMANCE on a synthetic widened head -- it is NOT a trained 4-arm policy and makes no accuracy claim.
why_only_these_two_graphs: Of the whole GR00T action head, only action_encoder (projects the action vector in) and action_decoder (projects it out) depend on action_dim. The DiT diffusion body (runs x4 denoise steps, ~92% of head latency), the VL self-attention, and the state encoder are DoF-INVARIANT -- they do not know how many arms exist. The ViT+LLM backbone likewise does not.

method.RTX_5090_and_Orin: speed/arms_2v4/bench_2v4.py: 5 fresh fp16 engine builds per (stage, dim), each the CUDA-event mean of 300 executes
method.Thor: speed/arms_2v4/bench_2v4_trtexec.sh: 3 fresh builds per (stage, dim), trtexec --fp16 --iterations=2000 --avgRuns=2000 --noDataTransfers --useSpinWait, GPU Compute Time mean
method.why_multi_build: a single TensorRT build is a tactic lottery for these tiny graphs: one Orin single-build pass showed a bogus 2x encoder delta in the impossible direction; five builds collapsed it to 0.4223 vs 0.4233 ms

RTX_5090.unit: ms per CALL of each sub-graph (x4 per inference at 4 denoise steps)
RTX_5090.verdict: within build spread -> FREE. The ops are launch-bound at this speed (sub-0.05ms); action_dim is invisible.

Jetson_AGX_Thor.unit: ms per CALL of each sub-graph (x4 per inference at 4 denoise steps)
Jetson_AGX_Thor.verdict: within build spread (decoder swings ~0.01ms build-to-build) -> FREE. 4-arm total measured slightly LOWER = noise.

Jetson_AGX_Orin.unit: ms per CALL of each sub-graph (x4 per inference at 4 denoise steps)
Jetson_AGX_Orin.verdict: within build spread -> FREE. (Single-build artifact caught and discarded, see method.why_multi_build.)

per_inference.note: the encoder and decoder run once per denoise step, so per-inference deltas are 4x delta_total

headline: 2 -> 4 arms moves the DoF-dependent encoder + decoder by <=0.005 ms per module call (<=0.02 ms per policy call), within build-to-build spread on every board. Thor's delta is slightly negative (noise).
clocks: 5090 not locked (delta measured back-to-back, insensitive to absolute clock); Jetsons at their default governor
variable_check: ONNX shapes verified to differ before running: encoder input [.,16,32]->[.,16,64]; decoder output [.,49,32]->[.,49,64]
scope: synthetic widened head; timing only -- NOT a trained 4-arm policy, no accuracy claim
